voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: The best time is the morning, when the mist lifts off the valley. Wear comfortable shoes for the steep path. This was a monastery, so keep your voice low inside and do not touch the frescoes. Entry is paid, and the Turkish museum pass is valid. Local tip: on the way back, stop by the stream for grilled trout or Akçaabat meatballs. Your next stop is the Atatürk Mansion, about forty-four kilometres by car, around fifty minutes.
